5. 7. Default configuration values will be extracted directly from Fabric source code into YAML files in a new config_defaults/ directory, with one file per core component (peer, orderer, configtx, etc.), and the existing sampleconfig/ directory will be deprecated but retained for backward compatibility.

For certificate fingerprint validation (U6), organizations opting into the feature are responsible for the availability and security of their fingerprint list endpoints (for endorsement-time mode) or the security of their fingerprint list signing keys (for channel-loaded mode); no additional high availability or key management features are included in this increment.

Existing test network scripts in the fabric/test/ directory are fully functional; the test network quick start (U7) only requires documentation updates and a simple entrypoint script, no new test network tooling or script rewrites are needed.
The existing fabric/sampleconfig/ directory will be deprecated but not removed in this increment to avoid breaking existing users who reference it.
